The number of benefits that a permanent lunar colony are functionally limitless. The technology to build it doesn't really exist, now. Not in the ways it needs to. But developing that technology will not only give us a moon base, it'll advance our overall technological level by leaps and bounds.

Materials science, cultivation, refining technology, not to mention shielding and miniaturization, are the bare minimum areas where advancement is necessary.

Do you like the computer you're using to brows the Internet for porn and cat pictures? You have the space race to thank for it. The things a lunar colony will lead to can't even be imagined, they're so far beyond our technical horizon.
